title: neodryas fredericae
intro: Neodryas fredericae, commonly known as "Mangrove fern", is a plant species found in tropical coastal areas. The Mangrove fern is known for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. Research has shown that this plant has several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions in treating wounds, skin conditions, and other diseases. The bioactive constituents of Neodryas fredericae include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
